title: CI/CD pipeline: lint, test, build, and push stages defined and correctly ordered

test_cases.name: CI stage contains lint and test steps
test_cases.input_setup: Parse azure-pipelines.yml; inspect CI stage jobs
test_cases.expected_result: CI stage present with ruff/lint and pytest/test steps
test_cases.evidence: CI stage found with lint + test steps; all stages: ['CI', 'BuildPush', 'DeployDev', 'DeployStaging', 'DeployProduction']

test_cases.name: Docker image tagged with shortSha (git commit)
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect azure-pipelines.yml for shortSha usage in Docker tags
test_cases.expected_result: shortSha variable defined and used in image tags
test_cases.evidence: Docker image tags include $(shortSha) from git commit

test_cases.name: azure-pipelines.yml is syntactically valid YAML
test_cases.expected_result: Parses successfully; dict with 'stages' key containing ≥3 stages

test_cases.name: Ruff lint command uses specific error selectors
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect CI stage ruff command in azure-pipelines.yml
test_cases.expected_result: ruff check with --select E9,F63,F7,F82 or equivalent
test_cases.evidence: ruff lint command present with error code selectors (E9, F63, F7, F82)
